report:
Pancreas and spleen, tail of pancreas, distal pancreatectomy and splenectomy

Received in formalin is a distal pancreatectomy and splenectomy specimen measuring 180 x 90 x 50 mm. The pancreas measures 110 x 40 x 30 mm and the spleen measures 115 x 75 x 40 mm and weighs 160 g. The pancreatic transection margin and the anterior and posterior surfaces are inked in different colours and the pancreas is serially sliced in the sagittal plane. There is a firm, ill-defined pale tumour centred on the tail of pancreas measuring 35 x 30 x 25 mm. The pancreatic duct is dilated to 6 mm upstream. The splenic hilar and peripancreatic lymph nodes are dissected and submitted. Representative sections are taken; see block key.

(1-4) Tumour with posterior surface.
(5) Proximal pancreatic margin, en face.
(6) Splenic hilum.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Distal pancreatectomy with splenectomy
- Tumour site: Tail of pancreas
- Tumour size: 3.5 cm (unifocal invasive carcinoma, greatest dimension)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Ductal adenocarcinoma, NOS
- Histologic grade: G2, moderately differentiated
- Tumour histology:
  The tumour is a moderately differentiated ductal adenocarcinoma, NOS, extending into the peripancreatic soft tissue and splenic vein or artery. Haphazardly arranged infiltrating glands with incomplete lumina and luminal necrotic debris are set in abundant desmoplastic stroma, lying immediately adjacent to muscular vessels and nerves, and show marked variation in nuclear size within individual glands. The tumour cells express CK7. There is loss of nuclear SMAD4 (DPC4) expression.
- Sites involved by direct extension: Peripancreatic soft tissue and Splenic
  vein or artery
- Pancreatic surface involvement: Not identified
- Lymphovascular invasion: Present
- Perineural invasion: Present
- Treatment effect: No known presurgical therapy
- Precursor lesion: Pancreatic intraepithelial neoplasia, high grade (PanIN)

Margins
- Proximal pancreatic parenchymal margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma,
  12 mm
- Posterior surface: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 0.5 mm
- High-grade dysplasia at the margins: Not identified

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: 14 examined; 2 involved
  - Number examined: 14
  - Number involved: 2
  - Stations involved: 10 (splenic hilum): 1 and 11 (splenic artery): 1
  - Extranodal extension: Not identified
  - Size of largest metastatic deposit: 4 mm, station 11

Distant metastasis
- Distant metastasis: Not identified

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT2 pN1
  - Stage group (if cM0): IIB

Additional findings
- Chronic pancreatitis

PANCREAS AND SPLEEN, tail of pancreas, distal pancreatectomy and splenectomy
- DUCTAL ADENOCARCINOMA, NOS, moderately differentiated, 3.5 cm, extending into
  the peripancreatic soft tissue and splenic vein or artery; lymphovascular
  invasion present; perineural invasion present; posterior surface 0.5 mm
  (margin positive at 1 mm or less); proximal pancreatic margin clear (closest
  12 mm); see synoptic report
- 2 of 14 regional lymph nodes involved
- pT2 pN1 (AJCC 8th edition), stage IIB (if cM0)

checks.message: Extrapancreatic extension is recorded with a tumour of 4 cm or less. In the eighth edition pT follows size alone, so this remains pT1 or pT2; extension no longer raises it to pT3.
Posterior surface is 0.5 mm from the carcinoma; at 1 mm or less this is reported as a positive margin (R1) in pancreatobiliary resections.
